title: Agent Task Queue with Leases
signature: class TaskQueue: __init__(clock, log, visibility_timeout=30.0, max_deliveries=3), enqueue(task_id, priority, payload), lease(worker), heartbeat(lease_id), ack(lease_id), nack(lease_id), sweep(), dead_letters()
hints: Start every public method with the same expiry sweep at clock.now(). Expiry is lazy, but it must look exactly as if it happened on time.
A lease id names one delivery: f"{task}#{delivery}". Only the task's current lease id is valid, so a zombie worker's old id is automatically stale.
Check 'already done' before 'current lease' in ack, so a retried ack is a quiet duplicate instead of a second completion.
Expiry and nack share one release path: back to ready, or to the DLQ once deliveries reach max_deliveries.
